Rising from the surf, salt water streams off odd squirming maggot-like pillars, with a strong paddle-like tail, the illithisk bursts out of 
the shallow tide. Scythe-like claws extended and grabs at a nearby vinnirex, a pained bark cut short by the mandibles biting deep into 
its fur. Within a heart beat of the flailing beast, paralyzing toxins built up over time by the symbiotic host of urchin on its back quickly 
silences the canine as the crustacean drags it under the waves. Although they are often the prey for larger predators, both from land and 
sea, this crustacean has an edge over the other diminutive scavengers that plague the beaches by the use of processing a toxin from the 
symbiotic urchin on its back, able to take down creatures that would otherwise crush its feeble form. 
Class - Malacostraca • Genus Derived Evolution - Nephropides • Niche - Amphibious Generalist Carnivore 
Preyed upon by - Daellash, Slannethiss, Vortautilus • Preys on - Daugon, Gharril, Rauka, Vinnirex
Encountering Ever watchful of the comings and goings on the 
shoreline, two unblinking beady eyes are often seen peering 
over the waves in search of easy prey or stalking predators. 
Th ese cunning predators can be tricked by a clever Traveler, 
feigning weakness or injury on the beach is a sure way to goad 
the creature into slowly approaching. Th ough caution is advised, 
as they can launch themselves out of the water aggressively with 
little warning.
